title: A jacket that harvests drinking water from the air
summary: Researchers at the University of Texas have developed an innovative jacket that can harvest drinking water from ambient air humidity, using advanced moisture-absorbing materials integrated into the garment's fabric.
problem_solved: Provides portable access to clean drinking water for outdoor workers, military personnel, or people in water-scarce environments by extracting moisture from air.
why_valuable: Addresses critical water security challenges by enabling autonomous water generation in emergency situations or remote locations where traditional water sources are unavailable.
